title: Hundreds March Against Planned ICE Detention Site in San Antonio
detail: Hundreds marched about 2.5 miles along East Houston Street and Loop 410 to the warehouse at 542 SE Loop 410, planned to hold up to 1,500 ICE detainees. Organizers urged the city to sue to block the facility; Mayor Gina Ortiz Jones had said a day earlier she would back legal action.
